records.assessment: Complete single-hunk patch only allows dead-code elimination of the verity work handler when CONFIG_FS_VERITY=n. SDK has CONFIG_FS_VERITY=y, so the added constant condition is true and changes no selected-target behavior. Native enabled_steps still prevents verification work on inactive files, including alternate disabled configurations; keep LTS code and avoid an off-configuration size optimization unrelated to this target. This does not omit a verification or memory-safety fix.

Complete three-file patch only relocates read_folio/readahead from inode.c to readpage.c and changes internal linkage/declarations. Keep the native file organization and internal functions. Required early prefetch was adapted at those native call sites in dcfd52aea1b7; inlining/file location is not an Android userspace or vendor source API requirement. Original trace, inline-data fallback and native read paths remain; no LTS fix is displaced.

Complete ext4 lookup-consolidation patch examined. It caches the verity pointer in bio_post_read_ctx and changes helper arguments to amortize the later hash-table lookup. The port retains inode-owned native acquire-load lookups instead of the hash table, so retain native ext4_need_verity, inode-based context setup and native verification calls. Early prefetch is separately adapted, with active/EOF guards. Both holes and the separately retained cleancache hit path verify before marking a folio uptodate, and verity_work frees its mempool context before nested read/decrypt work. No new security or Android-visible operation from this internal argument refactor is omitted; real performance was not measured.

scope: Complete original patches, current code and native delta reviewed; no live filesystem test.
